question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing fullback, Bob is playing sweeper, Claire is playing right winger, Dave is playing right midfielder, Eve is playing right back, Fred is playing left midfielder, and Gertrude is playing cheerleader.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Eve and Fred trade positions. Then, Claire and Bob trade positions. Then, Dave and Bob trade positions. Then, Claire and Fred trade positions. Then, Alice and Dave trade positions. Then, Eve and Bob trade positions. Finally, Eve and Claire trade positions. At the end of the match, Dave is playing
Options:
(A) fullback
(B) sweeper
(C) right winger
(D) right midfielder
(E) right back
(F) left midfielder
(G) cheerleader
solution:
Positions in each row are listed in this order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: fullback, sweeper, right winger, right midfielder, right back, left midfielder, cheerleader
1. Eve and Fred swap: fullback, sweeper, right winger, right midfielder, left midfielder, right back, cheerleader
2. Claire and Bob swap: fullback, right winger, sweeper, right midfielder, left midfielder, right back, cheerleader
3. Dave and Bob swap: fullback, right midfielder, sweeper, right winger, left midfielder, right back, cheerleader
4. Claire and Fred swap: fullback, right midfielder, right back, right winger, left midfielder, sweeper, cheerleader
5. Alice and Dave swap: right winger, right midfielder, right back, fullback, left midfielder, sweeper, cheerleader
6. Eve and Bob swap: right winger, left midfielder, right back, fullback, right midfielder, sweeper, cheerleader
7. Eve and Claire swap: right winger, left midfielder, right midfielder, fullback, right back, sweeper, cheerleader
Dave is playing fullback, option (A).
Final answer: (A)
